question: Should Control UI assistant messages get a Markdown/plain-text copy-format affordance, and should the approved shape be a compact per-click menu rather than a persisted preference?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested behavior, but adding a new visible message action or persisted preference is a user-facing UX choice rather than a broken existing contract.

options.title: Approve compact copy-format menu
options.body: Add a small Markdown/plain-text chooser on the existing copy affordance, define conversion behavior, and cover both clipboard outputs in focused tests.

options.title: Prefer persisted default preference
options.body: Add a user preference only if maintainers want repeated copy behavior configurable despite the extra settings surface.

options.title: Decline extra copy surface
options.body: Keep the current markdown-only copy button and close the request as outside the current Control UI scope.

recommendation.title: Approve compact copy-format menu
recommendation.body: Add a small Markdown/plain-text chooser on the existing copy affordance, define conversion behavior, and cover both clipboard outputs in focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the current copy-as-markdown behavior and recently touched the moved Control UI chat rendering surface.
